SELECT
  top_drg.drg_definition AS drg_definition,
  top_drg.drg_total_discharges AS drg_total_discharges,
  city_stats.city AS city,
  city_stats.city_discharges AS city_discharges,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(city_stats.weighted_total_payments, city_stats.city_discharges) AS weighted_avg_total_payments
FROM (
  -- find DRG with highest total discharges in 2014
  SELECT
    drg_definition,
    SUM(total_discharges) AS drg_total_discharges
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX = '2014'
  GROUP BY drg_definition
  ORDER BY drg_total_discharges DESC
  LIMIT 1
) AS top_drg
JOIN (
  -- for that DRG, get discharges and weighted total payments by city, take top 3 cities
  SELECT
    provider_city AS city,
    SUM(total_discharges) AS city_discharges,
    SUM(average_total_payments * total_discharges) AS weighted_total_payments
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX = '2014'
    AND drg_definition = (SELECT drg_definition FROM (
        SELECT drg_definition, SUM(total_discharges) AS drg_total_discharges
        FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_*`
        WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX = '2014'
        GROUP BY drg_definition
        ORDER BY drg_total_discharges DESC
        LIMIT 1
    ))
  GROUP BY provider_city
  ORDER BY city_discharges DESC
  LIMIT 3
) AS city_stats
ON TRUE
ORDER BY city_stats.city_discharges DESC

WITH prescriptions_2014_sel AS (
SELECT
  p.nppes_provider_state AS state,
  p.drug_name AS medication,
  -- Use total_claim_count as the prescription_row_count when available; fall back to 1 per row
  COALESCE(p.total_claim_count, 1) AS prescription_row_count,
  -- construct a stable prescription_id at the row level using available fields (npi + drug_name + state + total_day_supply)
  -- keep as string so it's joinable; callers can hash if needed
  CONCAT(p.npi, '::', SAFE_CAST(p.total_day_supply AS STRING), '::', p.drug_name, '::', p.nppes_provider_state) AS prescription_id
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.part_d_prescriber_2014` AS p
WHERE
  p.nppes_provider_state IS NOT NULL
  AND p.drug_name IS NOT NULL
  -- restrict to year 2014 data source (table is specifically 2014); keep literal pulled out of view if needed
  -- no additional date filtering needed because table is the 2014 dataset
),
state_medication_counts_agg AS (
SELECT
  nppes_provider_state AS state,
  drug_name AS medication,
  -- prefer summed total_claim_count when available; otherwise fall back to counting rows
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(total_claim_count) IS NOT NULL THEN SUM(total_claim_count)
    ELSE COUNT(1)
  END AS prescription_count
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.part_d_prescriber_2014`
WHERE
  nppes_provider_state IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  nppes_provider_state,
  drug_name
),
state_max_count_agg AS (
SELECT
  nppes_provider_state AS state,
  MAX(total_claim_count) AS max_prescription_count
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.part_d_prescriber_2014`
GROUP BY
  nppes_provider_state
),
top_medications_per_state_join AS (
SELECT
  smc.`state` AS state,
  smc.`medication` AS medication,
  smc.`prescription_count` AS prescription_count
FROM
  -- per-state, per-medication counts (reuse of state_medication_counts_agg if available)
  `state_medication_counts_agg` AS smc
JOIN
  `state_max_count_agg` AS smm
ON smc.`state` = smm.`state`
AND smc.`prescription_count` = smm.`max_prescription_count`
ORDER BY smc.`state`, smc.`medication`

SELECT
  s.state,

  s.prescription_count
FROM
  state_medication_counts_agg s
JOIN

WITH
-- identify provider with highest total inpatient Medicare cost across 2011-2015
inpatient AS (
  SELECT
    provider_id,
    CAST(_TABLE_SUFFIX AS INT64) AS year,
    total_discharges,
    average_medicare_payments
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_*`
  WHERE CAST(_TABLE_SUFFIX AS INT64) BETWEEN 2011 AND 2015
),
outpatient AS (
  SELECT
    provider_id,
    CAST(_TABLE_SUFFIX AS INT64) AS year,
    outpatient_services,
    average_total_payments
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.outpatient_charges_*`
  WHERE CAST(_TABLE_SUFFIX AS INT64) BETWEEN 2011 AND 2015
),
provider_total_inpatient AS (
  SELECT
    provider_id,
    SUM(IFNULL(average_medicare_payments,0) * IFNULL(total_discharges,0)) AS total_inpatient_cost_2011_2015
  FROM inpatient
  GROUP BY provider_id
),
top_provider AS (
  SELECT provider_id
  FROM provider_total_inpatient
  ORDER BY total_inpatient_cost_2011_2015 DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
-- yearly inpatient costs for top provider: sum of (avg_medicare_payments * total_discharges) per year,
-- then average of that value per year (since each year has one aggregated sum, average = that sum; kept as AVG for clarity)
yearly_inpatient AS (
  SELECT
    i.year,
    AVG(IFNULL(i.average_medicare_payments,0) * IFNULL(i.total_discharges,0)) AS yearly_inpatient_cost
  FROM inpatient i
  JOIN top_provider t USING (provider_id)
  GROUP BY i.year
),
-- yearly outpatient costs for top provider: average of (average_total_payments * outpatient_services) per year
yearly_outpatient AS (
  SELECT
    o.year,
    AVG(IFNULL(o.average_total_payments,0) * IFNULL(o.outpatient_services,0)) AS yearly_outpatient_cost
  FROM outpatient o
  JOIN top_provider t USING (provider_id)
  GROUP BY o.year
)
-- final: list each year 2011-2015 with both metrics
SELECT
  y AS year,
  COALESCE(yi.yearly_inpatient_cost, 0) AS yearly_inpatient_cost,
  COALESCE(yo.yearly_outpatient_cost, 0) AS yearly_outpatient_cost
FROM UNNEST([2011,2012,2013,2014,2015]) AS y
LEFT JOIN yearly_inpatient yi ON yi.year = y
LEFT JOIN yearly_outpatient yo ON yo.year = y
ORDER BY year

WITH quinapril_concepts AS (
  -- include the concept itself and all descendant concepts
  SELECT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept_ancestor`
  WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 35208
  UNION DISTINCT
  SELECT 35208 AS concept_id
),
quinapril_drug_concepts AS (
  -- limit to concepts that appear in drug_exposure or drug_era to reduce scanned data
  SELECT DISTINCT c.concept_id
  FROM quinapril_concepts c
  JOIN (
    -- gather distinct drug_concept_id values from small sampled scans of drug_exposure and drug_era
    -- using EXISTS style to let BigQuery prune scans: scan only the concept table join output
    SELECT drug_concept_id FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.drug_exposure` LIMIT 1
  ) de ON TRUE
  -- join back to concept table to keep scan scope minimal (this expression helps optimize planning)
  WHERE TRUE
),
persons_with_quinapril AS (
  -- find persons with any exposure to quinapril concepts by scanning drug_exposure and drug_era,
  -- using a UNION of two filtered scans. Each subquery projects only needed columns.
  SELECT DISTINCT person_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.drug_exposure`
  WHERE drug_concept_id IN (
    SELECT descendant_concept_id FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept_ancestor` WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 35208
    UNION DISTINCT SELECT 35208
  )
  UNION DISTINCT
  SELECT DISTINCT person_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.drug_era`
  WHERE drug_concept_id IN (
    SELECT descendant_concept_id FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept_ancestor` WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 35208
    UNION DISTINCT SELECT 35208
  )
),
total_persons AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) AS total
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.person`
)
SELECT
  tp.total AS total_participants,
  COALESCE(pq.count_exposed, 0) AS participants_exposed_to_quinapril,
  tp.total - COALESCE(pq.count_exposed, 0) AS participants_not_exposed,
  ROUND( SAFE_DIVIDE(tp.total - COALESCE(pq.count_exposed, 0), tp.total) * 100, 4) AS percent_not_using_quinapril
FROM total_persons tp
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) AS count_exposed
  FROM persons_with_quinapril
) pq
ON TRUE

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS stations_with_90pct_or_more
FROM (
  SELECT
    s.usaf,
    s.wban,
    -- count of valid days in 2019 where temp, max, min are not missing (not 9999.9)
    COUNTIF(
      gs.temp IS NOT NULL AND gs.temp != 9999.9
      AND gs.max IS NOT NULL AND gs.max != 9999.9
      AND gs.min IS NOT NULL AND gs.min != 9999.9
    ) AS valid_days_2019,
    -- number of days in 2019 (non-leap-year -> 365), but we compute possible days as days between 2019-01-01 and 2019-12-31 inclusive = 365
    365 AS possible_days_2019
  FROM
    `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations` s
  JOIN
    `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*` gs
  ON
    s.wban = gs.wban
    AND s.usaf = gs.stn
  WHERE
    -- restrict shards to include 2019
    _TABLE_SUFFIX = '2019'
    -- station period began on or before 2000-01-01 and ended on or after 2019-06-30 (or blank/null treat as still active)
    AND PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', CONCAT(SAFE_SUBSTR(s.begin,1,4), SAFE_SUBSTR(s.begin,5,2), SAFE_SUBSTR(s.begin,7,2))) <= DATE '2000-01-01'
    AND (
      s.`end` = '' OR s.`end` IS NULL
      OR PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', CONCAT(SAFE_SUBSTR(s.`end`,1,4), SAFE_SUBSTR(s.`end`,5,2), SAFE_SUBSTR(s.`end`,7,2))) >= DATE '2019-06-30'
    )
    -- only include rows in 2019 (redundant with _TABLE_SUFFIX but keeps safety)
    AND SAFE_CAST(gs.year AS INT64) = 2019
  GROUP BY
    s.usaf,
    s.wban
  HAVING
    -- require station recorded at least one valid day (and thereby had valid temperature data in 2019)
    valid_days_2019 > 0
)
WHERE
  -- stations that achieved at least 90% of possible days
  valid_days_2019 >= CEIL(0.90 * possible_days_2019)

-- Compute monthly new user funnel for 2021 with reduced scanned bytes by:
--  - Scanning only necessary columns
--  - Filtering users to 2021 before joining posts
--  - Using EXISTS with LIMIT via ARRAY(SELECT 1 FROM ... LIMIT 1) patterns to short-circuit
WITH users_2021 AS (
  SELECT
    id AS user_id,
    DATE_TRUNC(DATE(creation_date), MONTH) AS month_start,
    DATE(creation_date) AS creation_date
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.users`
  WHERE creation_date BETWEEN TIMESTAMP('2021-01-01') AND TIMESTAMP('2021-12-31 23:59:59')
),
-- questions posted by new users within 30 days of their creation_date
user_first_question AS (
  SELECT
    u.user_id,
    u.month_start,
    MIN(DATE(p.creation_date)) AS first_question_date
  FROM users_2021 u
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` p
    ON p.owner_user_id = u.user_id
   AND p.creation_date BETWEEN TIMESTAMP(u.creation_date) AND TIMESTAMP_ADD(TIMESTAMP(u.creation_date), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
  GROUP BY u.user_id, u.month_start
),
-- among users who asked within 30 days, find if they posted an answer after their first question and within 30 days after that first question
user_answer_after_first_question AS (
  SELECT
    q.user_id,
    q.month_start,
    -- existence flag: 1 if they posted at least one answer meeting the criteria
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` a
      WHERE a.owner_user_id = q.user_id
        AND a.creation_date > TIMESTAMP(q.first_question_date)
        AND a.creation_date <= TIMESTAMP_ADD(TIMESTAMP(q.first_question_date), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
      LIMIT 1
    ) AS answered_within_30_after_first_q
  FROM user_first_question q
)
SELECT
  FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', month_start) AS month,
  COUNT(*) AS new_users,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.first_question_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), COUNT(*)) * 100 AS pct_asked_within_30_days,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.answered_within_30_after_first_q THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN f.first_question_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)
  ) * 100 AS pct_of_askers_who_answered_within_30_after_first_q
FROM users_2021 u
LEFT JOIN user_first_question f
  ON u.user_id = f.user_id
LEFT JOIN user_answer_after_first_question a
  ON u.user_id = a.user_id
GROUP BY month_start
ORDER BY month_start

SELECT
  day_of_week,
  ROUND(100 * SAFE_DIVIDE(answered_within_hour, total_questions), 4) AS percent_answered_within_hour
FROM (
  SELECT
    day_of_week,
    COUNT(1) AS total_questions,
    SUM(IF(min_answer_delta_seconds IS NOT NULL AND min_answer_delta_seconds <= 3600, 1, 0)) AS answered_within_hour
  FROM (
    -- For each question, find its creation time and the earliest answer creation_time (if any)
    SELECT
      FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%A', q.creation_date) AS day_of_week,
      q.id AS question_id,
      q.creation_date AS question_creation,
      MIN(a.creation_date) AS first_answer_creation,
      IF(MIN(a.creation_date) IS NULL, NULL,
         TIMESTAMP_DIFF(MIN(a.creation_date), q.creation_date, SECOND)
      ) AS min_answer_delta_seconds
    FROM
      `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` AS q
    LEFT JOIN
      `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` AS a
    ON
      a.parent_id = q.id
    GROUP BY
      day_of_week, q.id, q.creation_date
  )
  GROUP BY
    day_of_week

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers`

  SELECT
    id AS question_id,
    owner_user_id AS question_owner_user_id,
    SAFE_CAST(view_count AS INT64) AS view_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions`
),
-- aggregate per-question total answer score and rank answers by score
answer_stats AS (
  SELECT
    a.*,
    q.view_count,
    SUM(a.answer_score) OVER (PARTITION BY a.question_id) AS total_answer_score,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.question_id ORDER BY a.answer_score DESC, a.answer_id) AS answer_rank_desc
  FROM answers a
  LEFT JOIN questions q
  ON a.question_id = q.question_id
),
-- determine whether an answer meets any of the criteria
qualified_answer_users AS (
  SELECT
    DISTINCT
    CASE WHEN a.answer_user_id IS NOT NULL THEN a.answer_user_id ELSE NULL END AS user_id,
    a.question_id,
    a.view_count
  FROM answer_stats a
  WHERE
    -- answer exists by a user
    a.answer_user_id IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      -- answer's score > 5
      a.answer_score > 5
      -- OR answer's score > 20% of total answer score (and > 0)
      OR (a.total_answer_score IS NOT NULL AND a.total_answer_score > 0 AND a.answer_score > 0 AND SAFE_DIVIDE(a.answer_score, a.total_answer_score) > 0.20)
      -- OR answer is among top 3 highest-scoring answers for that question
      OR a.answer_rank_desc <= 3
      -- OR answer is the accepted answer for the question (join to posts_questions)
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q
        WHERE q.id = a.question_id
          AND q.accepted_answer_id = a.answer_id
      )
    )
),
-- users who own questions (association by ownership)
question_owner_users AS (
  SELECT
    DISTINCT question_owner_user_id AS user_id,
    question_id,
    view_count
  FROM questions
  WHERE question_owner_user_id IS NOT NULL
),
-- combine all associations (owners + qualified answer users)
all_associations AS (
  SELECT user_id, question_id, view_count FROM qualified_answer_users
  UNION DISTINCT
  SELECT user_id, question_id, view_count FROM question_owner_users
),
-- sum view counts per user across distinct questions they are associated with
user_views AS (
  SELECT
    u.id AS user_id,
    u.display_name,
    SUM(a.view_count) AS combined_view_count
  FROM all_associations a
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.users` u
    ON u.id = a.user_id
  GROUP BY u.id, u.display_name
)

  user_id,
  display_name,
  combined_view_count
FROM user_views

    EXTRACT(DATE FROM creation_date) AS creation_date,

)

  SUM(CASE WHEN answered_within_hour_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS answered_within_hour_count,

    WHEN 'Saturday' THEN 6
